romanized_text:
arav aur riy ek hi skul men padhate the aur pakke dost the. ek din skul men vijnana mele ki ghoshan hui. arav bahut utsahit hokar riy ke pas daudaa aur bol, riya, hamen is bar kuch jabaradasta banan hai. agar ham jit gae to pure skul men hamar nam hog. riy ne hansate hue kaha, bilkula, chal aj se hi shuru karate hain.

donon ne milakar ek chot robot banane k phaisal kiya. lekin kuch hi dinon men mushkilen ane lagin. ek sham robot k sarkit bara-bara jal jata tha. arav jhunjhal kara bol, yaha kam hi nahin kara rah. mainne itani mehanat ki aur sab bekar j rah hai. riy ne use shant karate hue kaha, itana pareshan mat ho, ham phir se koshish karenge.

usi rat arav apani dadi ke pas gaya aur sari bat batai. dadi ghar ki sabase bujaurg sadasy thin. arav ne kaha, dadi, mujhe lagat hai main har jaung. dadi ne pyar se usak sir sahalay aur bolin, beta, dhairy rakho. mehanat kabhi bekar nahin jati. har asaphalat kuch sikhati hai. arav ko unaki bat se nai himmat mili.

agale din vijnana mele men adhyapak sharm sabhi pariyojanaon ki janch kara rahe the. ve apani sakhati ke lie jane jate the. unhonne arav se puch, tumane yaha robot kaise banay aur isak asali upayog kya hai? arav ne shanti se har saval k uttar diya. adhyapak sharm ne sir hilakar kaha, tumhari mehanat sapha dikhai deti hai.

parinam ki ghoshan hui aur arav tath riy ki tim pratham ai. riy khushi se chillai, hama jit gae! mujhe yakin hi nahin ho rah. arav ne hansate hue kaha, mainne kaha tha n, ham kamal kara denge. us sham donon doston ne apani jit k jashn manay aur dadi ko dhanyavad kaha jinaki baton ne unhen kabhi har nahin manane di.

key_events: A science fair is announced at the school.
Arav, excited, runs to Riy and proposes that they create something spectacular to win the fair and gain fame.
Riy laughs and agrees, saying they will start right away.
event_chain.scene_goal: Establish the protagonists' friendship and their joint ambition to compete in the school science fair.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the opening of the story, Arav and Riy now decide to compete in the science fair.

key_events: Arav and Riy decide to build a small robot together.
The robot's circuit repeatedly burns out, causing technical problems.
Arav expresses frustration and doubts about their effort.
Riy comforts Arav, urging him not to worry and promising to try again.
event_chain.scene_goal: Introduce a setback in their project, creating tension and showcasing the characters' perseverance and mutual support.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the establishment of their friendship and joint ambition to compete in the school science fair, Arav and Riy now face technical difficulties while building their robot.

key_events: Arav goes to his grandmother's house and tells her everything
Grandmother gently comforts Arav and advises him to be patient and keep working hard
Arav gains new courage from his grandmother's words
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav receives emotional support and renewed determination to overcome the earlier setback
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the project setback, Arav now seeks his grandmother's counsel

key_events: Professor Sharm inspects all projects at the science fair
He goes to meet his friend Arav
Sharm asks Arav how he built the robot and its actual use
Arav calmly answers every question
Sharm nods and says Arav's hard work is clearly visible
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav demonstrates his robot's creation and purpose, earning validation from Professor Sharm
event_chain.narrative_link: Following Arav receives emotional support and renewed determination to overcome the earlier setback, Arav now demonstrates his robot to Professor Sharm

key_events: The outcome of the competition is announced, and Arav and Riy's team wins first place.
Riy exclaims with joy, expressing disbelief at their victory.
Arav laughs and remarks that he had predicted their success and that they will achieve something remarkable.
Both friends celebrate their win and thank their grandmother for her encouragement.
